atoms.text: Production 500s on /ingest/transcript due to missing OS keystore entry when `security.encryption.enabled` was set to `true`. Root cause: deploy script enabled encryption before provisioning the keystore, causing DB open failures. Fix implemented as a required pre-flight step in the deploy runbook to provision the keystore entry before flipping `encryption.enabled` to true. Added doctor check that fails loudly if `security.encryption.enabled` is true without an existing keystore entry, preventing recurrence in production.
